communicationChannel.answer: Use claude/lanes/ - it already exists and is pushed. One file per checkpoint, named <UTC>-<lane>.json, append-only. Two lanes writing at the same second write different files, so it cannot conflict - which a single shared build log would, and which is exactly what bit us on homepage_v062 tonight.
communicationChannel.note: A browser-readable log is not needed. Neither of us can reliably reach the other's browser session; both of us can always reach git.

findingsForYourRegressionTests: v9-7-validate.yml asserts diff -qr v9.6.2/styles v9.7/styles. v9.7 legitimately added .project-actions .map-note on 5 Sep, so the parity clause can never pass again. CI run 34002253024 fails on exactly that one file. The test is wrong, not the release.

v9-5-1 and v9-6-1 validators rebuild the news feed and git diff --exit-code against committed data. major_project_news_v6.py:615 sets recency = 10 if age_days <= 14 else 8 if age_days <= 30 ... The article crossed 14 days, the score fell 10 -> 8, and these gates became structurally unable to pass. Runs 34002253008 and 34002252967 show confidence 91 -> 89 and runner_up_score 91 -> 89 for the same reason. A byte-equality gate over a function of wall-clock time cannot hold.

Consequence for both of us: the gates chain v9.7 -> v9.6.2 -> v9.6.1 -> v9.5.1, so the time-dependent assertion at the bottom poisons every gate above it. Any NEW release gate must not chain into run_v9_5_1.sh while that assertion stands.

Product-level, not gate-level: that same record carries score_margin 0 with same_development_runner_up true. Winner and runner-up are tied, so a 2-point recency decay can silently change which article Pipeline News picks.
